title: CCID: document 261-byte short-APDU limit as hard architectural constraint
description: src/wp11_ccid.c enforces a 261-byte cmdlen guard and uses 522-byte frame buffers. If extended-length APDUs are ever added, libusb will silently truncate at 522 bytes with no error -- the CCID response header stays valid but the data payload is clipped. This constraint must be documented in CLAUDE.md and in a comment at the cmdlen guard so contributors know that extending APDU support requires enlarging both buffers and the guard.
